description.value: Bobadog is a Victoria counter-service spot with an inventive fusion menu pairing Asian-inspired hot dogs — topped with kimchi, Japanese BBQ sauce, pineapple salsa, or imitation crab — alongside a large selection of bubble teas, sparkling boba, and fruit teas. The eclectic combination makes it a distinctive quick-stop for cyclists passing through downtown Victoria. The compact format and varied drink menu suit a mid-ride refuel.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Clover online ordering page confirms the address (1108 BLANSHARD ST, VICTORIA BC) and phone ((778) 432-2622) match OSM exactly. The page shows 'Closed' and 'isn't accepting online orders right now,' which appears to reflect the fetch occurring outside business hours rather than permanent closure — the full menu remains published and OSM flags looks_closed=false with active opening hours. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most optional amenities, so those are null. The online ordering platform and takeout-format menu (hot dogs, boba) confirm takeout service.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Bobadog Bubble Tea & Hot Dogs' while the Clover website displays 'BOBADOG Bubble Tea and Hotdogs' (ampersand vs 'and', 'Hot Dogs' vs 'Hotdogs'). Likely styling differences on the platform rather than a different business.

Website showed 'Closed' and 'isn't accepting online orders right now' at time of fetch — consistent with outside-hours status given OSM opening hours, but worth monitoring if the business has reduced operations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Victoria restaurant with confirmed address, phone, and a full published menu. A distinctive quick-service stop suitable for touring cyclists in the downtown core.
